name: Cash In Forecast 5
definition: Cash movements into a fund as a result of investment funds transactions, eg, subscriptions or switch-in.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

SubTotalAmount.name: Sub Total Amount
SubTotalAmount.definition: Sub-total amount of the cash flow in, expressed as an amount of money.

SubTotalUnitsNumber.name: Sub Total Units Number
SubTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Sub-total amount of the cash flow in, expressed as a number of units.

ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator.name: Exceptional Cash Flow Indicator
ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the estimated cash flow in is exceptional.

CashInBreakdownDetails.name: Cash In Breakdown Details
CashInBreakdownDetails.definition: Breakdown of cash in amounts by transaction and order type.

AdditionalBalance.name: Additional Balance
AdditionalBalance.definition: Additional balances for cash amounts and number of units. |In an estimated report, the total cash derived from orders placed as a number of units is an estimated cash amount and the total number of units derived from orders placed as a cash amount is an estimated number of units.

AdditionalBalanceRule.definition: If AdditionalBalance is present, then at least one or more elements in the list (AdditionalBalance/TotalUnitsFromUnitOrders, AdditionalBalance/TotalUnitsFromCashOrders, AdditionalBalance/TotalCashFromUnitOrders, AdditionalBalance/TotalCashFromCashOrders) must be present.
